race.description: NSW Jockeys Association Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: Even contest with half the field on debut. ESNAAD (5) is a Tassort filly from Group winning mare Enthaar on debut for the Michael Freedman yard. Wasn't pushed out in her two recent trials and the booking of Tommy Berry is a good lead to her chances. Maps well and can figure prominently. PURE ECSTASY (10) chipped away late on debut with a respectable fifth over 1000m at Tamworth. Has further upside in this stronger contest. Each way contender. LET THERE BE DRUMS (7) Exceedance filly returning for her second campaign. Held her round to the line on debut when fifth over 1000m at Hawkesbury four months ago. Showed enough when second in a recent Hawkesbury trial to suggest she's strengthened over the break. Right in this. SIMPLE PLEASURES (11) resumes. Kicked off in a strong contest on debut when ninth to Bangkok Hottie over 1200m at Warwick Farm last April. Finished second in a recent 800m Beaumont trial and drawn to get the right run. Can take a hand in the finish.
